passages.text:
PARTICIPATE
ATENEO
COVEININ
Formins Landers, Lendine Roforma
ASOG/PARTICIPATE and FACEBOOK Exploratory Meeting
6 August 2021 | Via Zoom
Attendees:
ASOG: Dr. Ron Mendoza, Ivy Baysic, Jurel Yap, and Armi Magno
FACEBOOK: Claire Amador and Nixon David
USAID: Joey Mendoza
Discussion Points
The meeting was shared with Facebook's initiatives on the
1. Impact of disinformation to elections decisions and behavior
- Is there specific information that can affect Filipino behavior?
2. Training for COMELEC field offices on resiliency (mental health)
and digital literacy)
3. Conversation with COMELEC and the ads industry for elections:
industry code of conduct and ads policies for elections
advertising
- Facebook is proposing to serve as a thinking partner for
political ads/spending
Follow up items from Facebook:
4. Inclusion of question/s for ASOG's survey
- Facebook's interest is on a national representative survey to
get a sense of how misinformation can affect choices, and
possibly for the information to be fed to Facebook central
office
Next Steps
Interface and collaboration on the following:
1. Mis/disinformation and fake news
- ASOG to share with Facebook any
information in relation to those spreading
misinformation
- ASOG can consider including some rider
questions on its ongoing study on social
media (discussion on methodology and
roll-out is underway); ASOG to get back to
Facebook on the inclusion of the possible
question; The newly released PPSJ article is
meant to jumpstart the discussion on
uncovering the relationship between fake
news and presidential approval survey; Can
we really trust the results given factors like
herd behavior and proliferation of fake news?
2. COMELEC engagement/assistance

PARTICIPATE
ATENEO
AL
CHOOL C
MIN
Formins Landers, Lendine Roforma
- Facebook has an upcoming RTD around September 2021: to
serve as a scene setting to communicate how Facebook is
preparing for the elections.
The meeting was shared with ASOG's initiatives on the following:
1. ASOG/PARTICIPATE Impact Evaluation Study
- The study aims to understand the effectiveness of the reach
of the IECs developed by PARTICIPATE - Are we reaching
beyond the choir to hopefully build a lasting lobby needed to
address the challenge on voter's education campaigns.
- The study also attempts to assess what actually works in
terms of voter's education.
- Its main innovation is the use of language translation, and
theorizes that the latter may possibly mitigate divisive
reactions.
2. COMELEC Engagement
- The strategy to engage both the central office and its
bureaus, the latter mainly to partner on capacity building
activities (e.g., scholarships for the staff) while the former for
the initiatives related to COVID proofing the elections
3. Misinformation Initiative
- ASOG has an ongoing effort via a fake news quiz to be
launched through an app similar to the one carried out by
Factitious; The App is for the public and is meant to serve as
a learning device to understand the public's ability to
determine fake news.
4. Work on BARMM
- Facebook, through Claire, and ASOG to link
up on possible DBM contacts in relation to
COVID-proofing initiatives
- Facebook and ASOG to coordinate on the
training/capacity development assistance it
will extend to COMELEC, as applicable. Note
that COMELEC has undergone internal
reorganization and talks with respective
offices may need to be revisited.
3. Impact evaluation
- Facebook to extend possible assistance on
mentoring about running ads in relation to
ASOG's impact evaluation study
(methodology on split-testing)

PARTICIPATE
ATENEO
Formins Lenders, Lendina Roforma
-
ASOG shared its work with CSOs in BARMM while Facebook
mentioned that it has exploratory discussions in relation to
digital marketing and literacy; financial inclusion
